summary: Micromem Technologies filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, announcing it adopted semi-annual financial reporting under CSA Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933, so it will stop filing third-quarter interim statements for the period ended July 31 and will report twice yearly. The company scheduled its Annual General Meeting for December 10, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. EST, with materials to follow. No transaction, price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. Watch for AGM materials and any financing needs given reduced reporting cadence.
